rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page's own text layer) names the item. Amounts print the writer's official text (1,234.56) in single text cells. Item 7's second comb line carries the rest of the address in its 31 fillable slots before the printed 7A caption and the ZIP Code in its last 4 (right of the printed ZIP caption); with the first line, the page-2 whole TIN, they come from derived: keys of to_print_field_map, never the XML. Booleans fill X in the box left of the printed option. Part III alphalists are DAT attachments and stay blank.
